title: Separate the Digits in an Array
summary: Given an array of positive integers, return an array containing the digits of each integer in the same order they appear, where separating a digit means extracting each digit from an integer in the order it appears.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, return an array containing the digits of each integer in the same order they appear, where separating a digit means extracting each digit from an integer in the order it appears.
constraints: Replace each positive integer by its decimal digits from left to right.
Preserve the original order of numbers and the digit order within each number.
Return one flattened list of integer digits.
reference_solution:
def separate_array_digits(nums):
    return [int(char) for number in nums for char in str(number)]
hints: Iterate numbers in their original order.
Convert each number to a decimal string and iterate its characters left to right.
Convert each character back to an integer and append it.
The nested iteration order exactly matches the required number-major then digit-major output.
editorial: The nested iteration order exactly matches the required number-major then digit-major output.
